meta.scope: 12-mode isolated single-pass measurement, recordizer off; one QUIC repeat
limitations: COMPLETED means measurements collected, not performance acceptance.
TCP P=1, 8 seconds per direction; UDP 100/500 Mbps, 5 seconds, upload only.
Qeli CPU sampling lasts test seconds plus one; includes workload edges. RSS peak is sampled.
Recordizer is off; historical 0.8.0 used prefer with recordizer active. No equivalent A/B was run.
Reality uses a local TLS target, with handrolled=true for real TLS.
Existing host services remain running; baseline is not a stability or canary gate.
QUIC 500 Mbps loss varied; receiver counters do not localize all losses.
No IPv6, per-app, failover or physical certification is earned by this benchmark.
